summary: Verified iteration_15 fix for public portal access tracking. Bug (novos acessos not registered in admin panel) is FIXED. All 5 test scenarios PASS: (1) fresh home load POSTs /api/track/access with visitor_id, gets 200 {ok:true}, no CSP errors, localStorage.__visitor_id and sessionStorage.__track_access_done are set; (2) reload of home does NOT POST again (sessionStorage dedup); (3) direct /inscricao access does NOT POST (path early-return); (4) two distinct browser contexts produce two distinct visitor_ids, both POST 200; (5) admin GET /api/admin/accesses (endpoint is /api/admin/auth/login for token) returns all 4 test visitor_ids just created.

minor.issue: Same visitor_id (vms0nvpwv_0oxrms2z) appears twice in list - dedup window is 30 min but a duplicate slipped through in one case. Non-blocking, but the $gte window logic in admin_routes.py L197-210 should be reviewed if this repeats.

integration_issues.issue: One console warning observed in later test contexts: '[track] /api/track/access TypeError: Failed to fetch' from inline HTML line 350 - however, the actual POST always succeeded with status 200 and visitor_id was stored in DB. Likely a stale early fetch before window.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was resolved or a duplicate inline script race. Not blocking but should investigate whether there are two tracking init calls (inline + external tracking.js) running simultaneously.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate why one visitor_id appears twice in /api/admin/accesses (30-min dedup should prevent this).
OPTIONAL: Investigate console warning '[track] TypeError: Failed to fetch' — appears to come from inline tracking. Actual persistence works but the noise suggests a duplicate/early init call.
critical_code_review_comments: inicio.html is ~800KB with all Tailwind CSS + daisyUI inlined. Consider offloading static CSS. Not related to bug.
tracking.js line 174 uses `res.ok || res.status < 500` to mark done — a 4xx will still mark done and NOT retry. This is intentional but could hide validation errors silently.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 tracking records via home visits + 1 manual POST (visitor_ids: vms0nvpwv_0oxrms2z, vms0nw10a_q96cxhw4, vms0nw4ba_2m2ag10j, test_manual_xxx). All persisted in DB and returned by /api/admin/accesses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from iteration_15 (CSP blocking /api/track/access) is RESOLVED. inicio.html no longer has restrictive CSP meta. tracking.js correctly gates sessionStorage.__track_access_done on successful POST response. Admin login endpoint is /api/admin/auth/login (not /api/admin/login). Use returned token as Bearer for /api/admin/accesses.
rca of the issue: N/A - this iteration verified the fix from iteration_15. Root cause was CSP meta `default-src 'none'` in inicio.html which blocked all fetch requests to /api/track/access. Fix: removed/relaxed CSP + gate sessionStorage on POST success. All verified working end-to-end.
